annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard names no bound parties; it only notes that the user of the standard is responsible for establishing appropriate safety and health practices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to establish appropriate safety and health practices and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This specification is provided as a consensus standard in support of an application to a nation’s governing aviation authority (GAA) for a permit to operate a small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ASTM F3002-14a Standard Specification for Design of the Command and Control System for Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS)
